name_reason: Compliant game-global name. Prefix data_fd2_ correct; domain 'animation' matches the .object2 animation tables in anitab.c; descriptor 'status_overlay_flicker_color_template' accurately reflects the per-status-effect color template used by the status-effect overlay flicker animation and conveys the data type (template/table). No Ghidra address residue in the suffix.
purpose: Per-status-effect silhouette colour template for the 'status effect applied' full-screen flicker animation: one VGA palette index per status kind.
logic_summary: Sole reader fd2_animate_status_effect_overlay_flicker (@0x1C2DA) copies all 30 bytes to a stack scratch (MOV ECX,7; MOV ESI,0x51F15; REP MOVSD; MOVSW = 7 dwords + 1 word = 30 bytes), then per culled-in target loads tmp[status_kind] with MOVZX (byte ptr [ESP+EBP*1], stride 1; EBP=status_kind=param_2) and passes it as the solid-color argument to fd2_tile_blit_24x24_solid_color (CALL 0x4DDD7). Most entries are 0xC0 (the flicker fill colour) with status-specific overrides 0x92/0x48/0xD8 at indices 17..19 and 0x23 at index 22.
element_semantics: One VGA 8-bit palette index per status-effect kind (status_kind index). Byte values: 0xC0 default flicker fill; overrides 0x92 (idx17), 0x48 (idx18), 0xD8 (idx19), 0x23 (idx22). The DWORD copy granularity is a memcpy optimisation, not a 4-byte element stride; the byte-wide MOVZX index access fixes element type uint8.
comment_original_issue: Comment was accurate but ended with a backward-looking NOTE ('Ghidra mislabelled this as int[4] len 16') describing a prior Ghidra state; Ghidra's live datatype is already byte[30]. Rewrote that trailing line into a forward-looking type-evidence statement (byte-stride MOVZX access + 30-byte REP MOVSD+MOVSW copy extent prove uint8[30]). All other comment content verified correct and kept.
notes: Verified against Ghidra ground truth: memory @0x51F15 = c0c0c0c0c0c0c0c0c0c0c0c0c0c0c0c0c0 9248d8 c0c0 23 c0c0c0c0c0c0c0 (30 bytes, byte-identical to src array). Live Ghidra datatype = byte[30] len=30; xrefs = exactly one READ (0x1C2FB) + one DATA base (0x1C2F6) from fd2_animate_status_effect_overlay_flicker, no writers -> const confirmed. Disassembly confirms 7xMOVSD+MOVSW=30B copy and MOVZX stride-1 index. Ghidra PLATE_COMMENT already present and consistent with src understanding (same reader, mechanism, overrides, const, uint8[30]) -> plate left unchanged. NEXTSYM at +0x10 is data_orphan_51f25_... an orphan label inside the array extent (unreachable flicker-final path), not a distinct table; the next distinct named table data_fd2_animation_spell_sprite_offset_table @0x51F33 (=+30) confirms the 30-byte boundary.
